hypothesis: At matched trainable parameter budget and shared collocation, cavity-geometry local scales improve a mixed strong-form PINN over a regular local decomposition, with evidence of competitiveness against half-bandwidth Fourier.
method_order: Listed order on C1; cyclic left shift by one per subsequent case; no concurrent GPU jobs.
geometry_local: Use frozen R2_P1 covers without modification.
uniform_local: n=round(sqrt(K_geometry)) cells along each bounding-box axis; omit core cells wholly outside solid using analytic boundary cuts; same overlap 1.5, compact windows, global channel and parameter allocation. Match total parameters; record remaining patch-count differences.

sampling.rule: Union of one geometry-only solid support probe per patch of BOTH local representations, deduplicated, plus uniform random solid points to reach 6000. All five methods receive byte-identical points and weights. C1/C8 share actual points.
sampling.interior_objective: 0.9 times uniform-point mean plus 0.1 times support-probe mean; auxiliary probe penalty is not an unbiased area quadrature.
sampling.boundary: Stratified per-curve parameter points, hole count allocated proportional to curve length; Jacobian-weighted hole mean. Outer edges each have their own mean. No corner point has an ambiguous normal.

initialization: Feature laws and float32 initialization streams reproduce original models.py construction, then all models train float32. Anchored and independent marginal share actual W and downstream weights. Local banks use existing P1 Xavier-uniform initialization with the same seed; local versus feature initialization cannot be identical.
precision: float32; TF32 disabled; deterministic PyTorch algorithms; process CPU threads 2

optimizer.name: ObservedLBFGS copied unchanged from first-round pure optimizer module
optimizer.budget_note: max_eval is checked after a completed line search and may be exceeded by that line search; actual accepted steps and closures recorded. No FEM early stopping or checkpoint selection.

freeze: Save initialization, registered reached checkpoints, terminal weights, loss components, complete accepted-step trace, source/input/protocol hashes. Freeze ALL 15 terminal states before opening FEM fields for evaluation. Evaluate terminals; checkpoints retained for later diagnostics only.

evaluation.primary: Relative U and S L2 errors at fine reference locations, both point means and area-weighted common integration locations where available; no pooling node and integration-point errors.
evaluation.spatial: Near-wall <=0.05, remainder, and for polygon cases corner-distance <0.02 versus remainder; weighted MAE and error quantiles; common-point fraction improved versus each control; full spatial predictions retained.
evaluation.engineering: Cavity wall displacement L2 and crown/invert/side displacement and convergence at prespecified geometric extrema, compared with fine FEM displacement interpolation; report absolute and relative errors, avoiding division by near-zero individual quantities.
evaluation.references: Existing verified fine references C1/C8 and slender g3; interpolation verification and all input hashes required before claims. No FEM-driven tuning.

screening.purpose: Single-seed finite-budget development screen, not confirmed scientific superiority.
screening.advance: Geometry/uniform ratio of geometric-mean area-weighted U and S relative errors over C1/C8/L1 <=0.90, with each individual U and S <=1.10 times uniform; wall displacement error <=1.10 times uniform in each case. In addition either both global U/S are within 1.10 times half Fourier on all three cases, or at least one of U/S improves by >=10% against half Fourier on at least two cases without the other exceeding 1.10 times half Fourier. Unavailable engineering/reference checks block an advance decision.
screening.stop: If these gates fail, do not add confirmation seeds or expand to T1/S1 under this protocol. Describe the finite-budget result and mechanism limitations; a materially new hypothesis requires a new protocol. No whole-method-family rejection from this screen.
screening.runtime_failure: Stop batch for nonfinite state, failed numeric preflight, insufficient device memory, unexpected concurrent project training, or input/source hash changes. Retain failure record, do not silently change precision, budget or sampling.

preflight: Before optimization: shared-point and parameter-budget checks; all local branches exercised; independent autograd checks of field Jacobians and objective gradients; original feature-law reproduction; GPU float32 finite loss and gradient check at full batch; unchanged optimizer equivalence on a small quadratic.
resource_logging: Record preparation, optimization, evaluation and peak allocated/reserved GPU memory as development telemetry only. No fair time-to-accuracy or efficiency claims without a separately confirmed idle window.
